`mvn clean test -B` now passes with jcabi-aspects still at 0.25.1: 703 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 6 skipped. I didn't touch any `@Ignore`/skip settings, so I'm assuming the 6 skips were already there. I didn't run the baseline to check.

The build broke because jcabi-aspects 0.25.1 no longer ships `com.jcabi.aspects.Tv`, the class of numeric constants (`Tv.TEN`, `Tv.THREE` and so on).

- **Main code:** the only use was `Tv.TWENTY` in `MkGithub.java`. I replaced it with the literal `20` and dropped the import.
- **Tests:** I added `src/test/java/com/jcabi/github/Tv.java` with the same constants the tests use (THREE through THOUSAND, plus BILLION). The test files that imported `com.jcabi.aspects.Tv` now import `com.jcabi.github.Tv` instead. Test files in the `com.jcabi.github` package itself just had the import removed.

I made no pom changes.
